{{Top|leg}}
A '''robo-vassal''' was a subordinate type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] employed in the service of the upper-class or well-to-do citizen. As of [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the presence of robo-vassals in a private residence indicated a certain level of luxury: for instance, robo-vassals could be found in the home of [[House Glayyd]], the most powerful of the ancient houses of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]].<ref name="hsr">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref>
